description: water from soaking beans before initial boil
preparation_notes: chill if not used within hours, keep from becoming anaerobic
usage_notes: used in lc or agar mix

name: MEA Agar
preparation_notes: bring up to a boil, and cool.

name: Distilled Water
preparation_notes: Use pharmaceutical-grade distilled water. Store in sterile containers.
storage_notes: Room temperature, sealed containers. Use within 1 week of opening.
usage_notes: Control baseline for all water comparisons. pH 7.0.

name: Filtered Tap Water
preparation_notes: Filter through activated carbon system. Let stand 10 minutes before use.

name: Rainwater
preparation_notes: Collect from clean roof. Filter through coffee filter. Let settle 24hrs.

name: Rice Cooking Water
description: Starchy water from rice preparation - FREE
preparation_notes: Save rinse and cooking water. Cool quickly. Strain if cloudy.
usage_notes: High energy for liquid culture. Outperformed commercial LME in trials.

name: Pasta Water
preparation_notes: Reserve 2 cups before draining. Cool rapidly. Light salt OK.

name: Lentil Soak Water
preparation_notes: Soak 100g lentils in 500ml water 12-24hrs. Strain, save liquid.
storage_notes: Refrigerate up to 72 hours. Rich amber color indicates good extraction.

name: Vegetable Scrap Broth
description: Complete mineral profile from kitchen waste
preparation_notes: Simmer mixed vegetable scraps 45-60min. Strain well.

name: Eggshell Powder
preparation_notes: Boil 5min. Dry at 200°F. Grind to fine powder.
usage_notes: pH buffer, calcium source. 1/2 tsp per 500ml. Critical for fruiting.

name: Commercial Agar
preparation_notes: Standard 15-20g per liter preparation.

name: Cardboard Extract
preparation_notes: Plain corrugated only. Soak 48hrs. Strain, use liquid.
storage_notes: Use fresh. Contains minerals and cellulose fragments.

name: Rye Grain
preparation_notes: Soak overnight, simmer 20min, drain, load jars.
storage_notes: Use immediately after prep and sterilization.
usage_notes: Standard spawn substrate. Baseline for comparisons.

name: Brown Rice
preparation_notes: Whole grain. Soak 12-24hrs, simmer 15min.
usage_notes: Slower than rye but cheaper. 88% success rate.

name: Wild Bird Seed
preparation_notes: Milo-based mix. Soak overnight, simmer 15min.

name: Coffee Grounds
description: Spent coffee grounds - FREE from cafes
preparation_notes: Fresh spent grounds. Use same day. Pre-sterilized from brewing.
storage_notes: Use within 24 hours. Refrigerate if needed.

name: Hardwood Sawdust
preparation_notes: Oak/maple mix. No chemical treatments. Sift for uniformity.
storage_notes: Keep dry. Check for mold before use.

name: Wheat Bran
preparation_notes: No prep needed. Add 10-20% by weight.
storage_notes: Cool, dry place. Use within 6 months.
usage_notes: Standard supplement. Provides nitrogen and structure.

name: Straw
preparation_notes: Chop to 2-4 inch pieces. Pasteurize 60-90min at 160°F.

name: Gypsum
preparation_notes: Agricultural grade. Mix dry with substrate.

name: yeast treated sweetened pasta water
preparation_notes: note- can be boiled to remove the biological component or used alive - anticipating synergy, lowering of ph by active yeast biota, use of aerated compost brew
